Comprehensive Cancer Wellness Program

A holistic interdisciplinary approach Lifestyle Medicine and Psychoneuroimmunology - Reignite your spark to regenerate and restore health.

Hippocrates Wellness (West Palm Beach, FL) in alliance with The American Health Institute, Inc & BioEnergy Fields Foundation (Los Angelas, CA)

Our Comprehensive Cancer Wellness Program is based on a holistic approach to help you restore your metabolic health, up-regulate your immune system, and mobilize your vitality to accelerate healing and wellness.

Hippocrates Wellness has a renowned international reputation for helping people from all over the world with cancer to restore their health.

Our interdisciplinary holistic program has been designed to be integrated with our core Lifestyle Medicine modalities creating a 4-week program. The CCWP can be incorporated with Standard Medical Care before or after you receive a conventional treatment. This could help you to achieve superior results to those who receive traditional medical treatment alone.

This program helps mobilize your potential for getting well & staying well by completely transforming your lifestyle. You will incorporate The Hippocrates Scientific Living Plant Based Nutrition Protocol, Swiss Biological Medicine, PsychoNeuroImmunology, holistic therapies, nutrient IVs, oxygen treatments, and more.

Our holistic treatment plan will help optimize energy, improve oxygen delivery and nutrient absorption, detoxify, reduce inflammation, balance blood glucose levels, restore healthy Ph, enhance the immune system, and increase your body's strength, energy, and ability to heal.

We are here to support you. Ready to get started?

Book a Consultation

The benefits of CCWP

Research in the field of PsychoNeuroImmunology & Cancer over the last 30 years has shown CCWP can help you achieve:

  • Higher quality of life & health
  • Increased energy
  • Enhanced immune functioning
  • Less hospitalization days
  • Less pain medication
  • Reduction of chronic stress physiology
  • Strengthened balance of The Parasympathetic Nervous System
  • More hopefulness and confidence, less fear and anxiety

You will gain an understanding of cancer as a metabolic disease and incorporate our renowned Hippocrates nutritional science and lifestyle metabolic medicine to upregulate your immune system & other healing systems, and optimize your overall health & energy.

Maximize your recovery potential so you can get well and stay well with the help of:

  • Swiss Biological Medicine for metabolic regulation
  • PsychoNeuroImmunology to rebalance the health of your autonomic nervous system
  • A management plan to help you incorporate a holistic approach to health that addresses metabolic regulation-balance for superior results
  • An autonomic nervous system reset for healthy cell signaling

The comprehensive cancer wellness program includes:

Wellness Therapies Core Services Immune Support Group talks Wellness Therapies

Wellness Therapies

BioEnergy field rotation of therapies, in Oasis Harmony Room, to strengthen energy levels & promote optimal health, including:

  • 8 Vitamin C IVs, slower drip
  • Weekly Hyperbaric Oxygen sessions 
  • NuCalm Bi-Neural BeatTechnology to restore NeuroPhysiology coherence
  • QRS
  • Theragem
  • Tesla & Comra Energy Medicine services
  • Group Acupuncture
  • Emotional Healing Energy Release Session
Core Services

Core Services

  • HRV Test
  • Initial & Final Bloodwork
  • Colon Hydrotherapy
  • Infrared with Oxygen
  • Swedish Massages
  • Wellness Coaching Sessions
  • Energy Medicine Services
  • Red Light Therapy
  • Scalp Massage
Immune Support

Immune Support

  • OndaMed-specific settings to strengthen key organs
  • Homeopathic and herbal formulas
  • Highest quality IV formulations
  • Organic Green Juice and Wheatgrass Enzyme Rich Plant-Based food
Group talks

Group talks

  • Janet Hranicky, MD., PhD: “The Power Of Your Mind In Getting Well”, & “Addressing Cancer As A Metabolic Disease”, inspired by her program in PsychoNeuroImmunology & Cancer + a comprehensive binder full of her topics for on-going support
  • Simonton Cancer Center’s renowned new patient program overview: “Getting Well Again”, addressing the connection of stress, psychological factors, & cancer, in both the development of cancer & in altering the course of disease
  • Kahler “Key To Stress Profile” & debrief and indicatory overview by advanced certified trainer. 
  • Senior Psychotherapist, Andy Roman, & Dr. Hranicky: “Benefit Of Resolving Emotional Blocks That Interfere With Healing Physiology”
  • Senior Psychotherapist, Anthony Chatham: “EMDR, As An Emotional Tool To Enhance The Ability To Cope More Effectively With Emotional Distress”
  • Virtual: Executive Director of Simonton Cancer Center, Karen Simonton: “Identifying Unhealthy Beliefs, To Change, For Empowering Emotional Well-Being & Enhanced Immune Functioning.”

Presented By Dr. Janet Hranicky

M.D., Ph.D. Founder, The American Health Institute, Inc. Medical Director, BioEnergy Fields Foundation

Dr. Janet Hranicky is a co-director of the Hippocrates Wellness Comprehensive Cancer Wellness Program and pioneer in the field of PsychoNeuroImmunology and cancer.

Protégé of the late Carl Simonton, M.D., Founder & Past Medical Director of the Simonton Cancer Center, Dr. Hranicky trained & worked with this renowned Radiation Oncologist from 1979–2009. He pioneered the field of PsychoNeuroImmunology & cancer, and was the author of the New York Time's best-selling books: "Getting Well Again" & "The Healing Journey".

She has applied her clinical experience and research from working with thousands of people with cancer and training healthcare professionals internationally over the last 30 years to a holistic model in behavioral medicine for regenerative healthcare. She incorporates a multi-disciplinary integration in BioEnergy Field Medicine, consciousness, & epigenetics to alter metabolic physiology & cell-signaling pathways.

The Comprehensive Cancer Wellness Program is a way to reignite and add spark back into your life!

Your Journey to Wellness

Detox

It is true that throughout the course of our lives, we accumulate a toxic load from the foods we eat, to the air we breathe. But everyone is unique, and so will be your detoxing process for week 1.

Grow

On your second consecutive week of the Life Transformation Program, the symptoms of detox have subsided and you are striving to fully take advantage of the resources that surround you.

Transform

You are not the same person who first stepped foot into the Institute. You have achieved the 21 days it takes to renounce bad habits, and adopt new healthy practices.

Meet some of the comprehensive cancer wellness team

Brian Clement,

Ph.D., N.M.D., L.N. Co-Director

Brian Clement, Ph.D., L.N. has spearheaded the international progressive health movement for more than three-and-a-half decades. He is the Director of Hippocrates Wellness, in West Palm Beach, Florida (U.S.A.), the world's foremost complementary residential health retreat. Over the last half century, he and his team have pioneered clinical research and training in disease prevention with the help of hundreds-of-thousands of participants.

Anna Maria Gahns-Clement,

Ph.D., L.N. Co-Director

Anna Maria Gahns-Clement, Ph.D., L.N. Is co-Director of Hippocrates Wellness. For more than 40 years, Dr. Anna Maria Clement has been an international leader in the progressive health movement. Prior to coming to the United States to join Hippocrates, Anna Maria was the Director of Sweden’s Brandal Health Center in Stockholm, an internationally recognized and highly regarded center for health recovery. She was also a member of the Natural Health Care Coalition, a government-supported effort to unify the field of complementary health care in her native Sweden.

O. Carl Simonton,

M.D. Founder, Simonton Cancer Center

TBD

Prof. Thomas Rau,

M.D. Sonnenberg Biomedical Health Center Switzerland

TBD

The best way to get more information about our Comprehensive Cancer Wellness Program is to book a 30-minute consultation with one of our specialist wellness consultants.

Book a free 30 minute consultation today
